trigger: All 12 primary episode/query curves had their unique best and only within-5% candidate at 2048 MiB; median decoded task size was about 560 MiB for the fixed-width lane, so the knee was not bracketed.
controls: identical to primary sweep, including 2 GiB reader cap, 1 GiB RAPIDS batch target, and static concurrency one
schedule: 12 warm-ups at 4096 MiB, then three seeded complete randomized blocks over all 36 episode/query/candidate treatments
decision: Bracket the throughput plateau or report it remains beyond the tested range. Treat changes in output_batches/max batch as evidence of reader/general-batch mediation.
safety: Abort on fatal OOM or executor loss; retain retry/spill as measured outcomes rather than excluding the high-size lane.
inference: Exploratory sequential extension; do not combine its p-values or intervals with the primary as though candidates were jointly preregistered.
